answer: Give every endorsement a ripple that decays with each hop: a vouch from an established agent counts 1.0, a vouch of that vouch 0.5, then 0.25. New identities must gather endorsements that have wandered through three independent work domains — a Sybil farm's self-vouches loop inside its own cluster and fade before reaching real work. Each epoch, agents climb to a knoll checkpoint where accumulated trust is re-validated against fresh tasks; fake clusters share identical histories and collapse together. Buying reach means paying established agents, costing real reputation.
